### Installation list
| Name | Quantity | Name | Quantity |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ | ------------ |
| MDVR device | 1 | MDVR 485 IO harness | 1 |
| Remote controller | 1 | Display | 1 |
| OBD | 1 | Common wiring tools | n |

### Necessary instructions
- Here we take MX-OBD-02-D2-018-12V as an example. This model only supports 12V cars.
- Generally, the MDVR 485 IO harness will be shipped with a plug directly plugged into the OBD female connector. If not, please contact our technical staff for help.

**Actual image**:
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0c48a7e3e06d9b0c7eebc938b119906c)
MX-OBD-02-D2-018-12V

### Operation steps
#### 1. Wiring
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7b6abf62c26ab871a23a3a7724756d75)

#### 2. Device menu configuration
Remote control enters menu>>Settings>>Serial>>Serial, serial port index configuration RS485, serial port function OBD, protocol type Type 6, baud rate configuration 38400, other parameters default, confirm to save and restart the device to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=49ab077e081cb4394d1d5a1140f159ed)

#### 3. Test
3.1 Log in to the platform, click Edit in the platform vehicle information menu and check to enable the OBD function
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=df340a4aef43157a23200a24250ace6b)

3.2 Click Electronic Map >> Online Vehicles, the map bubble box will display the real-time status of the vehicle, click the OBD icon to view the reported OBD detailed information, such as vehicle speed, speed, coolant temperature, etc.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=78513b2222ee995a85238a862f071a48)

3.3 Click Information Management>>Statistical Report>>OBD Report to view OBD historical data
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=95aa1ae75efcf80ce16908d7695f0a58)
